claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) is broadcast exclusively in the U.S. across the FOX Sports family of networks, including FOX, FS1, FS2, and FOX Deportes.
Games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed on FOXSports.com or FuboTV.
Streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include FOX Sports App, Fubo, and Tubi.
The semifinals and finals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are at loanDepot Park in Miami.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic is broadcast in Canada on Sportsnet (English) and TVA Sports (French).
The championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is scheduled for Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
